source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 22 exercise hal (PDF 206-207): MCQs jawab aur wajah ke saath, short, long aur inquisitive sawalon ke model jawab, numericals step by step, Kitab ki ghalti aur Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 22 (Biostatistics) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, long aur inquisitive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) diye gaye hain. Hisab wale sawal (numericals) Given → formula → steps → jawab ki tarteeb mein hal kiye gaye hain. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi; jawab chapter ke text se nikale gaye hain.
Section 1: Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
1. Which of the following is a primary data collection method?
(In mein se primary data jama karne ka tareeqa kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Primary data researcher khud seedha jama karta hai: experiments, surveys, interviews, observations aur clinical trials se. Government reports, published research aur databases secondary data hain (22.1.1).

blocks.prompt:
2. What does mode represent in a dataset?
(Dataset mein mode kis cheez ko zahir karta hai?)

options.text: Woh value jo sab se zyada baar aaye

blocks.explanation: Mode woh value (ya values) hai jo dataset mein sab se zyada baar aaye (22.2.3). Average to mean hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. Which statistical measure is also called the 50th percentile?
(Kaun sa statistical measure 50th percentile bhi kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: 50th percentile woh value hai jis se neeche 50% data ho; yahi median (darmiyani value) hai (22.2.6).

blocks.prompt:
4. If the maximum value in a dataset is 50 and the minimum value is 20, what is the range?
(Agar dataset ki sab se bari value 50 aur sab se chhoti 20 ho to range kya hogi?)

5. What does it mean if the 40th percentile value is 148cm?
(Agar 40th percentile ki value 148 cm ho to is ka kya matlab hai?)

options.text: 40% values 148 cm ya is se kam hain
Tamam values 148 cm ke barabar hain

blocks.explanation: Percentile woh value hai jis se neeche diya gaya percentage data hota hai: 40% observations 148 cm ya is se kam hain (chapter ki misaal ki tarah, 22.2.6).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Option (d) bhi taqreeban sahi lagta hai (baqi 60% oopar), lekin chapter percentile ki tareef "is se neeche ya barabar" ke alfaaz mein karta hai, is liye (b) behtareen jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
6. In a pie chart, what does the full circle represent?
(Pie chart mein poora circle kya zahir karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pie chart ka poora circle 100% data ke barabar hai, yaani 360° (22.3.2).

blocks.prompt:
7. What do error bars represents in a chart?
(Chart mein error bars kya zahir karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Error bars bar chart par lagi lakeerein hain jo data ki variability ya uncertainty dikhati hain; average (mean) to khud bar dikhata hai (22.3, Error Bars).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "What do error bars represents" chhapa hai; "do" ke baad "represent" hona chahiye: "What do error bars represent in a chart?"

blocks.prompt:
8. In an experiment, what does the dependent variable represent?
(Experiment mein dependent variable kis cheez ko zahir karta hai?)

options.text: Woh factor jo ek jaisa (constant) rakha jaye
Woh factor jise nazarandaz kiya jaye

blocks.explanation: Dependent variable woh hai jo naapa jata hai; yeh independent variable ke asar se badalta hai. Chhape options mein sirf (b) is se milta hai; (a) control variables ki tareef hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Koi option tareef bilkul theek nahi deta. "The factor being changed" (jise experimenter badalta hai) asal mein independent variable hai; dependent variable woh hai jo naapa jaye aur jawab mein badle. (b) ko murad jawab mana gaya hai, yaani "woh factor jo jawab mein badalta hai".

blocks.prompt:
9. What is the main purpose of including a control group in an experiment?
(Experiment mein control group rakhne ka asal maqsad kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Control group ko treatment nahi milti; yeh experimental group se muqable ke liye baseline (bunyaad) ka kaam deta hai (Steps of Experimental Design).

blocks.prompt:
10. Which group in an experiment receives the treatment?
(Experiment mein kaun sa group treatment leta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Experimental group ko woh treatment ya tabdeeli di jati hai jise test karna ho; control group ko nahi (Steps of Experimental Design).

blocks.prompt:
1. Explain why biostatistics is important in medical research?
Medical research mein biostatistics kyun zaroori hai?
blocks.explanation: Biostatistics studies (jaise clinical trials) ka design aur un ke data ka tajziya (analysis) karne ka tareeqa deta hai, taake nataij valid (durust) aur reliable (qabil-e-aitbaar) hon. Is se nayi dawaon, ilaj aur devices ki safety aur asar jaancha jata hai, aur doctor poori population ke bajaye sample data se saboot par mabni faisle karte hain.

blocks.prompt:
2. Describe the difference between descriptive and inferential statistics?
Descriptive aur inferential statistics mein farq bayan karein.
blocks.explanation: Descriptive statistics maujood data ka khulasa (summary) batate hain; inferential statistics sample ke data se poori population ke baare mein nateeja nikalte hain.

rows: Jama kiye gaye data ki khususiyat batate hain
Sample data se population ke baare mein nateeja nikalte hain
Misaal: mean, median, mode, standard deviation
Misaal: hypothesis testing, regression analysis, modelling
Data se aage nahi jate
Sample se aage poori population par lagu karte hain

blocks.prompt:
3. What is the relationship between percentiles and quartiles?
Percentiles aur quartiles mein kya taluq hai?
blocks.explanation: Quartiles khaas percentiles hain jo tarteeb wale data ko chaar barabar hisson mein baant-te hain: Q1 = 25th percentile, Q2 = 50th percentile (median), Q3 = 75th percentile.

blocks.prompt:
4. How are independent and dependent variables related in experimental design?
Experimental design mein independent aur dependent variables ka aapas mein kya taluq hai?
blocks.explanation: Independent variable woh factor hai jo experimenter badalta hai; dependent variable woh hai jo naapa jata hai aur us ke jawab mein badalta hai (sabab aur asar). Misaal: khurak ki qism (independent) aur choohon ka wazan barhna (dependent). Baqi sab factors control variables ke taur par ek jaise rakhe jate hain.

blocks.prompt:
5. The height of six children are 110, 115, 118, 120, 122, and 125. What is the median height of the children?
Chhe bachon ke qad 110, 115, 118, 120, 122 aur 125 hain. Median qad kya hai?
blocks.explanation:
Given: 110, 115, 118, 120, 122, 125; n = 6
Required: median
Step 1: Data ko barhti tarteeb (ascending order) mein likhein: 110, 115, 118, 120, 122, 125
Step 2: n = 6 juft (even) hai, is liye median (n/2)th aur (n/2 + 1)th values ki average hai, yaani 3rd aur 4th value = 118 aur 120.
Step 3: Median = (118 + 120)/2 = 238/2 = 119
Jawab: median qad = 119 (cm).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Juft (even) tadaad mein do darmiyani values pehle jama karein, phir 2 se taqseem karein: (118 + 120)/2. Bracket na lagayein to 118 + 120/2 = 178 ghalat jawab aa jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
6. What does a legend in a chart present?
Chart mein legend kya dikhata hai?
blocks.explanation: Legend chart ki key (rehnuma) hai jo batati hai ke us ke nishanat, rang, patterns ya labels ka kya matlab hai, maslan bar chart mein kaun sa rang kis category ka hai, taake data asaani se samajh aaye.

blocks.prompt:
7. What are error bars?
Error bars kya hain?
blocks.explanation: Error bars bar chart (aur doosre graphs) par lagi lakeerein hain jo data ki variability ya uncertainty dikhati hain, yaani data points bar wale mean se kitna door hain. Do aam qismein: range error bars (minimum se maximum tak) aur standard deviation error bars (mean ± SD).

blocks.prompt:
1. Explain the concepts of mean, median, and mode as measures of central tendency. Illustrate with examples when each measure would be most appropriate.
Central tendency ke measures ke taur par mean, median aur mode ki wazahat karein. Misaalon se batayein ke har ek kab sab se munasib hai.
blocks.explanation:
Central tendency ke measures poore data ki numaindagi karne wali ek darmiyani value dete hain.
1. Mean (average): tamam values ka jama, un ki tadaad se taqseem. Ungrouped data: mean = Σx/n. Grouped data: mean = Σfᵢxᵢ/Σfᵢ (xᵢ = class ka midpoint, fᵢ = frequency).
Misaal: paudon ke qad 56, 65, 74, 75, 76, 77, 80, 81, 91 cm → Σx = 675, n = 9, mean = 675/9 = 75 cm.
Kab munasib: jab numerical data mein bohat bari ya bohat chhoti (extreme) values na hon, maslan ek jaise halaat mein paudon ki average growth; yeh har value istemal karta hai.
2. Median: tarteeb wale data ki darmiyani value. n taaq (odd) ho to median = (n + 1)/2 position wali value; n juft (even) ho to do darmiyani values ki average.
Misaal: 110, 115, 118, 120, 122, 125 → median = (118 + 120)/2 = 119.
Kab munasib: jab data skewed (ek taraf jhuka) ho ya extreme values hon, maslan population size, bimari ka phailao (disease prevalence), jism ki paimaish; chand bari values ise nahi kheenchtin.
3. Mode: woh value jo sab se zyada baar aaye; ungrouped data mein formula ki zaroorat nahi. Grouped data: mode = l + [(fm − f₁)/((fm − f₁) + (fm − f₂))] × h.
Misaal: zoo ke janwaron ka wazan, modal class 30-40 kg (frequency 18): mode = 30 + (6/14) × 10 = 34.29 kg.
Kab munasib: categories ya sab se aam khususiyat ke liye, maslan paude par phoolon ki sab se aam tadaad, beejon ka sab se aam size, sab se aam blood group.
Khulasa: symmetric data ke liye mean, skewed data ya outliers ke liye median, sab se aam category ke liye mode.

blocks.prompt:
2. Describe standard deviation, range, and percentiles as measures of variability. Compare their advantages and limitations in interpreting biological data?
Variability ke measures ke taur par standard deviation, range aur percentiles bayan karein. Biological data samajhne mein un ke fawaid aur hudood (limitations) ka muqabla karein.
blocks.explanation:
Variability ke measures batate hain ke data kitna phaila hua hai.
1. Standard deviation (σ): data mean ke gird kitna bikhra hai. σ = √[Σ(xᵢ − µ)²/N]. Steps: mean nikalein, har value se mean minus karein, har farq ka square karein, squares ki average (variance) lein, phir square root. Misaal: paudon ke qad 56-91 cm, mean 75 cm, Σ(xᵢ − µ)² = 784, variance = 784/9 = 87.11, σ = 9.33 cm. Chhota σ = data mean ke qareeb; bara σ = data phaila hua. Paudon ki growth ya enzyme ki miqdar ki variability mein istemal.
2. Range: phailao ka sab se aasan measure, range = Xmax − Xmin. Misaal: 50 − 20 = 30. Bari range = zyada phailao.
3. Percentiles: woh value jis se neeche diya gaya percentage data ho. Rank R = P/100 × (n + 1); R poora number na ho to interpolation (do values ke darmiyan andaza) karein. Misaal: n = 10, 40th percentile R = 4.4 → 168 + 0.4 × 2 = 168.8 cm. 25th, 50th, 75th percentiles = Q1, median, Q3. Skewed ya normal biological data, maslan growth charts mein mufeed.
Muqabla: table dekhein.

rows: Standard deviation
Har value istemal; mean ke gird phailao ka durust paimana; SD error bars ki bunyaad
Hisab mushkil; extreme values se mutasir; taqreeban normal data ke liye behtar
Range
Sab se aasan aur tez; poora phailao dikhata hai
Sirf do values; ek outlier ise bohat badal deta hai; darmiyani values ka pata nahi
Percentiles
Data mein kisi value ki position batate hain; skewed data mein kaam karte hain; outliers ka asar kam
Tarteeb aur kabhi interpolation chahiye; phailao ka ek majmooi paimana nahi dete

blocks.prompt:
3. What are error bars? Explain their types (range error bars, standard deviation error bars) and significance in experimental biology. Illustrate your answer with a hypothetical dataset?
Error bars kya hain? Un ki qismein (range error bars, standard deviation error bars) aur experimental biology mein ahmiyat bayan karein. Ek farzi (hypothetical) dataset se samjhayein.
blocks.explanation:
Error bars: bar chart (aur doosre graphs) par lagi lakeerein jo data ki variability ya uncertainty dikhati hain, yaani alag alag data points bar wale mean se aam tor par kitna door hain. Har sire par chhoti cap lagti hai.
Qismein:
1. Range error bars: har group ki sab se chhoti (minimum) se sab se bari (maximum) value tak, data ka poora phailao.
2. Standard deviation (SD) error bars: mean se ek (ya zyada) SD oopar aur neeche (mean ± SD), data points ka mean se aust (average) faasla.
Experimental biology mein ahmiyat:
1. Mean kitna qabil-e-aitbaar hai: chhoti bars = dohrayi gayi readings milti julti; lambi bars = zyada farq.
2. Groups ka muqabla: do groups ki error bars bohat overlap karein to farq shayad asli nahi; door door hon to treatment ka asar ho sakta hai.
3. Qudrati biological farq aur naap ki ghalti imandari se dikhati hain, sirf mean par bharosa nahi hota.
Farzi dataset (gandum ke paudon ka qad cm mein, 2 hafte baad, har group mein 3 paude):
Baghair khaad: 20, 22, 24 → mean = 66/3 = 22 cm; range 20-24; farq −2, 0, 2; squares 4, 0, 4; variance = 8/3 = 2.67; SD = 1.63 cm.
Khaad (fertilizer) ke saath: 26, 30, 34 → mean = 90/3 = 30 cm; range 26-34; farq −4, 0, 4; squares 16, 0, 16; variance = 32/3 = 10.67; SD = 3.27 cm.
Chart: do bars 22 aur 30 cm par. Range error bars: 20 se 24 aur 26 se 34. SD error bars: 22 ± 1.63 aur 30 ± 3.27.
Nateeja: bars overlap nahi karteen, is liye khaad ne qad wazeh tor par barhaya; khaad wale group ki lambi bar batati hai ke us ke paudon mein farq zyada tha.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Dataset farzi (hypothetical) hai, jaisa sawal ne manga. Book ki apni misaal (bean plants, low/medium/high light: means 10, 15, 19 cm, har group mein SD ≈ 1, range ± 1) bhi isi tarah likhi ja sakti hai.

blocks.prompt:
4. Compare and construct bar charts and pie charts. Which situations favour one over the other? Support your answer with real-world biological or health data examples.
Bar charts aur pie charts ka muqabla karein aur banayein. Kin halaat mein ek doosre se behtar hai? Biological ya sehat ke data ki misaalon se jawab dein.
blocks.explanation:
Bar chart: x-axis par categories, y-axis par values ya frequencies; bar ki oonchai value ke tanasub (proportion) mein; bars ki chaurai aur faasla barabar.
Bar chart banana (chapter ki misaal: jungle mein keere: ladybug 45, ant 120, butterfly 30, bee 75, dragonfly 20):
1. Maqsad aur data: paanch species ki tadaad ka muqabla. 2. Axes: x = insect species, y = number of individuals. 3. y-axis 0 se 140 tak, 20 ke waqfe se. 4. Bars 45, 120, 30, 75, 20 tak, barabar chaurai, barabar faasla. 5. Labels, title aur rang hon to legend.
Pie chart: circle jo sectors (tukron) mein bata ho; poora circle = 100% = 360°; sector angle = (category value/total) × 360°.
Pie chart banana (chapter ki misaal: 100 students ke blood groups: A 30, B 20, AB 10, O 40):
1. Data table. 2. Total = 100. 3. Angles: A = 108°, B = 72°, AB = 36°, O = 144° (jama 360°). 4. Circle aur ek reference radius banayein, protractor se har angle; har sector alag rang. 5. Labels, legend aur title.
Kab kaun sa:
Bar chart behtar jab bohat si categories ya groups ki asal miqdar ka muqabla ho, ya values ek kul (whole) ke hisse na hon, maslan mukhtalif districts mein malaria ke cases, ya mukhtalif roshni mein paudon ka average qad (error bars bhi lag sakti hain).
Pie chart behtar jab ek kul ke hisse (percentages jo 100% banen) aur kam categories hon, maslan class mein blood groups ki taqseem, ya kul emissions mein har greenhouse gas ka hissa.

rows: x aur y axes par mustateel (rectangular) bars
Circle jo sectors mein bata ho, axes nahi
Bar ki oonchai value ke tanasub mein
Sector ka angle hisse ke tanasub mein (kul = 360°)
Categories ya groups ki miqdar ka muqabla
Ek kul (100%) ke hisse dikhata hai
Bohat si categories; error bars lag sakti hain
Kam categories ke liye behtar; error bars nahi
Misaal: jungle mein keeron ki species ki tadaad
Misaal: 100 students ke blood types

blocks.prompt:
5. Discuss different types of data presentation tools in biostatistics (bar chart, pie chart and error bars). For each, explain an appropriate biological example where it would be the best choice.
Biostatistics mein data dikhane ke mukhtalif tools (bar chart, pie chart aur error bars) bayan karein. Har ek ke liye munasib biological misaal dein jahan woh behtareen ho.
blocks.explanation:
Data dikhane ke tools numbers ko tasveer mein badalte hain taake patterns foran nazar aayen.
1. Bar chart: categorical data ko mustateel bars se dikhata hai jin ki lambai/oonchai value ke tanasub mein hoti hai; x-axis par categories, y-axis par values; bars khari ya leti, barabar chaurai aur faasla, title, axis labels aur legend ke saath.
Behtareen misaal: alag categories ki ginti ka muqabla, maslan jungle mein paanch keeron ki species ki tadaad (ladybug 45, ant 120, butterfly 30, bee 75, dragonfly 20); sab se oonchi bar (ants) foran nazar aati hai.
2. Pie chart: circle jo sectors mein bata ho, har sector kul ka hissa; poora circle = 100% = 360°; angle = (value/total) × 360°.
Behtareen misaal: ek kul ke hisse, maslan 100 students ke blood types: A 108°, B 72°, AB 36°, O 144°; O sab se aam group nazar aata hai.
3. Error bars: bars (ya points) par lakeerein jo variability ya uncertainty dikhati hain: range error bars (minimum se maximum) ya SD error bars (mean ± SD), siron par caps.
Behtareen misaal: dohraye gaye naap wale experiments, maslan kam, darmiyani aur zyada roshni mein bean plants ka average qad (10, 15, 19 cm, har ek ± 1 cm); error bars batati hain ke groups mein wazeh farq hai aur readings milti hain.
Nateeja: categories ke muqable ke liye bar chart, kul ke hisson ke liye pie chart, mean ki qabil-e-aitbaari dikhane ke liye error bars.

blocks.prompt:
1. A pharmaceutical company claims their drug improves recovery time from flu. Propose an experimental design using biostatistics principles, and explain how you would ensure validity and reliability of results?
Ek dawa company ka daawa hai ke us ki dawa flu se sehatyabi ka waqt behtar karti hai. Biostatistics ke usoolon par experimental design tajweez karein aur batayein ke nataij ki validity aur reliability kaise yaqeeni banayenge.
blocks.explanation:
Experimental design (chapter ke steps):
1. Sawal: kya dawa flu se theek hone ka waqt kam karti hai?
2. Hypothesis (mafrooza): jin mareezon ko dawa di jaye woh kam dinon mein theek honge.
3. Variables: independent = dawa di ya nahi; dependent = theek hone ka waqt (din); control variables = umar, jins, shuru mein flu ki shiddat, doosri dawayein, aaraam, khurak aur sehatyabi naapne ka tareeqa.
4. Groups: experimental group ko dawa; control group ko bilkul waisi dikhne wali nakli goli (placebo) (chapter se aage) ya aam ilaj.
5. Tareeqa: kafi bara aur milta julta sample chunein; mareezon ko random (bila tarjeeh) do groups mein baantein; muqarrara muddat tak ek jaisi dose; har mareez ka waqt ek hi tareeqe se likhein.
6. Analysis: har group ka mean (aur median) waqt, standard deviation aur range nikalein; SD error bars wala bar chart banayein; statistical test se dekhein ke farq significant (ahem) hai ya nahi (inferential statistics).
7. Nateeja: agar dawa wala group wazeh tor par jaldi theek ho to hypothesis qabool, warna radd.
Validity (test dawa ka asli asar naape): control group baseline; random taqseem taake groups ek jaise hon; sirf ek variable badla jaye; baqi factors control; blinding, yaani na mareez na doctor jaanta ho ke kis ko dawa mili (chapter se aage).
Reliability (nataij dohraye ja saken): kafi bara sample; baqaida, ek jaise naap; SD aur error bars report karein; trial doosri jagah dohrayein aur milte julte nataij milen; tareeqa saaf saaf likhein.

blocks.prompt:
2. Evaluate the usefulness of range versus standard deviation in representing variability. Which one would you trust more in medical research and why?
Variability dikhane mein range aur standard deviation ki ifadiyat (usefulness) ka jaaiza lein. Medical research mein kis par zyada bharosa karenge aur kyun?
blocks.explanation:
Range = Xmax − Xmin: bohat tez aur aasan, poora phailao dikhata hai, lekin sirf do intehai values istemal karta hai; ek ghair maamooli mareez (outlier) ise bohat badal deta hai aur baqi values ke phailao ka pata nahi chalta.
Standard deviation = √[Σ(xᵢ − µ)²/N]: har value istemal karta hai aur batata hai ke data mean ke kitna qareeb hai (chhota SD = qareeb, bara SD = phaila hua); SD error bars aur statistical tests ki bunyaad hai.
Misaal: theek hone ka waqt 5, 6, 6, 7, 20 din: range = 15 din, sirf ek 20 din wale mareez ki wajah se; SD paanchon mareezon ko shamil karta hai.
Medical research mein standard deviation par zyada bharosa kiya jata hai, kyun ke yeh tamam data istemal karta hai, ek intehai case par kam munhasir hai aur groups ka statistical muqabla mumkin banata hai. Range phir bhi pehli nazar ya intehai values (maslan sab se chhota aur bara mareez) batane ke liye mufeed hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. During an epidemic, mortality rate estimates vary depending on whether the mean, median, or percentile is used. Discuss how policymakers might misinterpret such statistics and how biostatistics can prevent this.
Wabaa (epidemic) ke dauran mean, median ya percentile istemal karne se mortality rate ke andaze badal jate hain. Policymakers in statistics ko kaise ghalat samajh sakte hain aur biostatistics is se kaise bacha sakti hai?
blocks.explanation:
Ghalat fehmi kaise hoti hai:
1. Mean intehai values se kheencha jata hai: chand districts ya hospitals mein bohat zyada amwaat (deaths) mean ko barha deti hain aur poora mulk asal se bura lagta hai; ya chand bohat kam values hotspots chhupa deti hain.
2. Median aakhri hissa chhupata hai: median aam ilaqa dikhata hai lekin sab se zyada mutasir ilaqe ya umar ke groups nazarandaz ho jate hain, aur madad un tak nahi pahunchti.
3. Percentile ka ghalat matlab: maslan "90th percentile mortality 5%" ko average rate ya "90% log mar gaye" samajh lena.
4. Apni marzi ka number chunna: control dikhane ke liye kam median, fund maangne ke liye zyada mean.
5. Kharab data: ghair numainda sample, amwaat ki reports ka na hona ya der se aana, ilaqon mein alag tareefein.
Biostatistics kaise bachati hai:
1. Sahi study design aur numainda (representative) sampling; ek jaisa data jama karna aur saaf karna.
2. Kai measures ek saath (mean, median, range ya SD, percentiles) wazeh tareef ke saath, taake data ki shakal nazar aaye.
3. Error bars aur charts se variability dikhana; umar, ilaqe aur risk group ke hisaab se data taqseem karna taake khatre wale log pehchane jayen.
4. Inferential statistics aur modelling se poori population ke rates ka andaza aur bimari ke phailao ki foran nigrani.
5. Policymakers aur awaam ko saaf aur shaffaf (transparent) batana, taake wasail aur hikmat-e-amli ke faisle saboot par hon.
